description: React component for displaying and managing installed incoming webhooks in Mattermost, including filtering, editing, and deleting webhooks.

classes.name: InstalledIncomingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for rendering an incoming webhook item with actions and details.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Function to determine if a webhook matches the filter criteria based on display name, description, and channel name.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Method to handle deletion of the webhook, calling the onDelete prop.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render method for displaying webhook details, actions, and URL.
